sources.name: Little Nan’s Bar

sources.name: Little Nan’s 2.0
sources.acquisitionMethod: Public official venue/status review; publication remains separately gated.
sources.notes: Original official venue page identifies downstairs Arch 23; the 2.0 page confirms Resolution Way and postcode SE8 4NT. Weekly hours are on linked Instagram and not independently readable. Avoid making separate duplicate public bars for each upstairs private-hire room. Candidate has no useful address. Name match is a lead; publisher must check original coordinates before importing or merging.

sources.name: Incognito Richmond
sources.acquisitionMethod: Public official venue/status review; publication remains separately gated.
sources.notes: Stale official contact page still lists Richmond and hours, but current site navigation only offers Winchester. CAMRA reports Incognito closed in 2024, replaced by Nowhere in 2025, itself closed and for sale in March 2026. Do not mark open from the stale contact page. Needs branch resolution rather than automatic active import.

sources.name: Little Mercies
sources.acquisitionMethod: Public official venue/status review; publication remains separately gated.
sources.notes: Official site search index returned current operating hours; direct page timed out. Address of 20 Broadway Parade, N8 9DE appears in independent guides but was not available from an official page during this check. Hold address as unverified until candidate/official source resolves it. OSM candidate says 20 Tottenham Lane, while independent guides use 20 Broadway Parade. Do not silently treat these as a proven alias before map/official confirmation.

sources.name: Incognito Kingston
sources.acquisitionMethod: Public official venue/status review; publication remains separately gated.
sources.notes: Both OSM candidates name Incognito at Market Place KT1 1JT. Check coordinates before dedupe. CAMRA records closure 1 August 2025; current official website only presents Winchester in navigation. Do not publish either as verified open or copy obsolete hours.

sources.name: Craft Metropolis Penge

sources.name: Dovetail Bar at Empire Casino
sources.acquisitionMethod: Public official venue/status review; publication remains separately gated.
sources.notes: Official search index confirms named bar at Empire Casino but direct retrieval is blocked by connection verification. Address is retained as unverified from supplied additional-candidates record. Apparent 24/7 hours in search index may be casino-wide footer, not bar hours. Do not inherit. OSM Dovetail node/12248980301 lies around Covent Garden and is not a safe match; The Dovetail EC1 is also a different venue.
